金色流星（金色流星（第22页）工地上的说笑声戛然而止。巴克呆呆地张着嘴，手里那半块视若珍宝的肉夹面包“啪嗒”一声掉进了脚下的煤灰里。他甚至忘记了去捡，只是在一种无法抗拒的本能驱使下，与身边数十名惊骇欲绝的工友一起，死死仰头看向夜空的最高处。只见一颗庞大到难以想象的金色流星，正以一种打碎世界的恐怖威势，从天幕的极致高处斜斜坠落！它拖曳出的纯金色尾焰贯穿了半个星空，犹如神明投下的裁决之枪，把下方王都的所有建筑、大桥、甚至河流泛起的每一朵波涛，都照耀得犹如极昼般分毫毕现。整座银辉城，在这一刻失声了。光。压倒一切的光。“那是什么？”有人跪倒在街边，喃喃自语。没人能回答。那颗金色流星一路向东，越过王都，越过河流，越过一望无际的东部平原，最后砸向无尽的东海。数十息后，遥远的海平线亮成金色，东海深处掀起一圈巨浪，远方渔村的钟声同时狂乱地敲响。深夜变成白昼，然后，光灭了。整个阿斯特利亚王国陷入死一样的安静。……几乎同一时间。北境凛冬城。值守在城墙上的年轻士兵看着南方夜空，手里的雷鸣步枪差点滑落，他转头看向身边的老兵，声音发颤：“长官，那……那是……”“闭嘴，别乱猜！”老兵咽了口唾沫，强行压下心底的震骇，一把抓起旁边的魔导通讯器：“全军戒备！一级战备状态！”“立刻向上级汇报！东部天穹生变！产生极高规格异象！”“请求执政官阁下紧急指示！”……更北方，亚人帝国边境，巨龙山脉以北。一队正在雪原上行军的狼族斥候同时停下了脚步。他们仰着头，看着那颗将地平线尽头染成纯金色的流星，感受到了一种源于血脉深处的威压。“吼……”副手喉咙里发出一声不受控制的低吼。“那到底是什么鬼东西……”副手握紧了武器，毛发倒竖。“不管是什么，这声势太浩大了。”狼族队长倒吸了一口凉气，果断下令，“立刻起笔，把这情况一字不落地汇报给莱昂纳德军团长！”与此同时，在靠近灰色沼泽边缘的某处隐秘营地。这里是阿雷克托斯暗中招兵买马、积蓄力量的据点。寒冷的夜风中夹杂着沼泽特有的轻微的腐气，但在几座被伪装网严密覆盖的巨大营帐间，却透出一股冷冽的肃杀。在亚人军团莱昂纳德将军的暗中输血下，这支秘密军队已初具规模。夜间巡逻的士兵们步伐沉稳，清一色穿着漆黑的、抹去了所有编号与徽记的魔导装甲。这些装备大多是从阿斯特利亚的黑市中以“报损”名义倒腾出来的，虽然外观去除了醒目标志，但却足以武装出一支能在乱世中撕开裂口的精锐。

Golden Meteor (Golden Meteor (page 22)) The chatter and laughter at the construction site stopped abruptly. Buck opened his mouth blankly, and the half piece of meat bread that he regarded as a treasure fell into the soot at his feet with a "clack". He even forgot to pick it up, but driven by an irresistible instinct, he and dozens of horrified workers around him looked up at the highest point of the night sky. Only one saw An unimaginably huge golden meteor was falling diagonally from the extreme heights of the sky with a terrifying force that shattered the world! The pure golden tail flame it dragged penetrated half of the starry sky, like a spear of judgment dropped by the gods, illuminating all the buildings, bridges, and even every wave in the river below as if it were the end of the day. The entire Silver City was lost at this moment. Sound. Light. Overwhelming light. "What is that?" Someone knelt down on the street, muttering to himself. No one could answer. The golden meteor went eastward, crossed the river, and finally hit the endless East Sea. Tens of seconds later, the distant sea level turned into gold, and a huge wave rose in the depths of the East Sea, and the bells of the distant fishing village rang wildly. The night turned into daylight, and then the light went out. ...Almost at the same time. The young soldier guarding the city wall in the south looked at the night sky in the south, and the thunder rifle in his hand almost slipped. He turned to look at the veteran next to him, his voice trembling: "Shut up, don't guess!" Suppressing the shock in his heart, he grabbed the magic communicator next to him: "The entire army is on alert! Level 1 combat readiness!" "Report to your superiors immediately! The eastern sky has changed! A very high-level abnormality has occurred!" "Requesting urgent instructions from the Archon!"... Farther north, at the border of the Asian Empire, north of the Dragon Mountains. A group of wolf scouts who were marching on the snowfield stopped at the same time. Looking at the meteor that dyed the end of the horizon pure gold, I felt a pressure coming from the depths of my blood. "Roar..." The deputy let out an uncontrollable roar. "What the hell is that..." The deputy clenched his weapon, and his hair stood on end. "No matter what it is, the momentum is too great." The wolf captain took a breath and ordered decisively, "Start writing immediately. Report this situation word for word to Captain Leonard! "At the same time, there is a secret camp near the edge of the gray swamp. This is the base where Alectos secretly recruits troops and accumulates strength. The cold night wind is mixed with the slight rotten smell unique to the swamp, but in several huge tents that are tightly covered with camouflage nets, there is a cold chill. In the demihuman army Leona Under the secret blood transfusion of General Germany, this secret army has begun to take shape. The soldiers patrolling at night are all wearing pitch black magic armor with all numbers and emblems erased. Most of this equipment was taken from the black market of Astralia in the name of "reporting damage". Although the eye-catching logo is removed from the appearance, it is enough to arm an elite force that can tear holes in troubled times.
